scope: Five existing public team-revocation cases only; not a full team-module score
behavior: A caller holds a public ORM identity in a reused session across transactions. Another session revokes its credential, principal, membership or verification, or removes project permissions. The next create_task call must deny access.
limitations: Focused test selection; another existing test may already detect this candidate in a complete module run.
Fault experiment uses SQLite. Unmutated PostgreSQL behavior is verified separately.
